title: Graphs with Minimum Algebraic Connectivity II: Regular Graphs of Even Degree
summary: Aldous and Fill (2002) conjectured the asymptotic maximum relaxation time of a random walk on a connected regular graph. Since the relaxation time of a $d$-regular graph $G$ is $d/μ(G)$, where $μ(G)$ denotes its algebraic connectivity, this conjecture is closely related to the problem of minimizing algebraic connectivity among regular graphs.
